blurb: Guests visit the taproom to enjoy a range of beers including hop-forward IPAs, Czech-style lagers, fruit and funk beers, and gluten-free seltzers. The brewery hosts regular events such as trivia nights, food trucks, and the quarterly Three Minute Thesis competition. Private event spaces are available for rent with audio and visual equipment.
